.qc-cache/hireops-workspace-2026-10-03-r7/rules/harbor-webdev-rubric-qc/SKILL.md (delivery profile: shaped 0.6/0.2/0.2 behind two zero-weight gates and a functional floor)
evidence: 1) Gates are 0.0 and carry no weight: task/tests/scoring.toml:1-3 '[gates] render = 0.0 constraints = 0.0'; [weights] (lines 5-8) list only functional 0.6/polish 0.2/visual 0.2 (sum 1.0); [floors] functional = 0.05 (line 11). File is byte-identical to the frozen template scoring.toml (diff empty; sha256 95f70d6e...bbba). score.py:46 computes weighted only over `weights`, so gate dimensions contribute no mass. Gate judge.tomls each hold one binary criterion with aggregation='all_pass' (hro_gate_render, hro_gate_shared). 2) Failed gate zeroes reward and skips scored: test.sh (identical to template, sha256 bd682592...aabe5aa) lines 212-222 run `run_suite gates 1500`, then score.py; exit 1 -> `exit 0` before line 224 `run_suite scored 11100`; any other non-zero -> write_zero_reward; line 213-215 a gates-suite failure/timeout exits with the pre-written zero (line 60 write_zero_reward, trap ensure_reward line 61). score.py (identical to template, sha256 13de2b38...c04e996eef5c04e) line 41 gates_passed = all(score > 0.0); line 42 scored only counted when gates passed; line 48 reward = 0 unless gates_passed and floors_passed; line 83 returns 1 on gate failure. 3) Executed the frozen score.py+scoring.toml (copied to scratchpad, python -B, hashes verified) on synthetic RewardKit outputs: gates {render:1,constraints:0} -> exit 1, reward 0.0000; gate fail with a perfect scored/reward.json present -> exit 1, reward 0.0000, functional/polish/visual reported 0; gates pass, functional 0.05 with polish=visual=1 -> reward 0.0000 (floors_passed 0, weighted 0.43 recorded only as diagnostic); missing gate dimension -> score.py exit 2 (test.sh line 221 then writes zero). Golden-like (0.9/0.8/0.75) -> 0.85. 4) Floor stops a non-working app farming polish/visual: functional has 43 binary criteria, total weight 58.5; floor requires functional > 0.05, i.e. more than 2.925 weight. An app that only does what the gate demands (sign-in, open job, add candidate, shared readback) can earn at most hro_job_open 0.5 + hro_add_candidate 0.5 = 1.0/58.5 = 0.017 -> reward 0 (simulated: 'gateonly_app' reward 0.0000 even with polish=visual=1). Additionally each scored prompt repeats the backend gate in-dimension (functional/polish/visual prompt.md line 11-13; visual line 12 'gives every criterion its minimum raw Likert score 1, which normalizes to zero'), so a static/dead app gets 0 in polish/visual independently of the floor. Polish criteria all require real live updates, failed-send and session behaviours, so they are not farmable by a dead app. Broken-app probe: a gate-only CRUD app with a beautiful UI -> 0 (floor). Conforming-alternative probe: a strong app that misses one gate cannot occur without failing the gate's actual product requirement (shared job+candidate create/readback is a core public requirement), and no weighting gives gates reward mass, so no conforming app is shaped downward by this row's mechanics. Note (not a defect, template-fixed policy): a partially working app clearing the 0.05 floor (e.g. job/candidate validation + restart persistence, ~0.06 functional) with good visuals could reach about 0.19 (simulated floor_just_pass: 0.6*0.06+0.2*0.75 = 0.186); this is the mandated shared floor/weights and is not a task-authoring defect. Risk=true because the end-to-end path (RewardKit gate suite returning a failed gate inside the configured verifier, test.sh skipping the scored suite, reward.json written) was not exercised: raw-evidence-index.json scope states 'Full configured grading/workload, reward discrimination/ranking and Oracle/target scores are absent'; only score.py was executed here and test.sh was verified by reading.
